Abstract

                  A discussion of the mechanisms of radiant heat transfer in gases containing particles is
                  presented.

The Mie theory equations for spherical particles were used to calculate the
                  adsorption, extinction, and scattering parameters of carbon at 3590' F, silicon at 80' F,

The application of these results to radiant heat
                  transfer calculations for the gaseous core nuclear rocket is discussed.
